title: Modeled dead-version backlog after ten minutes
method: Synthetic model starts at 100,000 eligible obsolete versions. Creation is 20,000/minute for ten minutes. Cleanup at 30,000/minute yields max(0,100,000+200,000−300,000)=0; cleanup at 15,000/minute yields 150,000. No blocked snapshots are assumed; this is not a benchmark.
alt: Modeled dead-version backlog after ten minutes. Starting backlog: 100000 row versions; Cleanup keeps up: 0 row versions; Cleanup falls behind: 150000 row versions. Illustrative values.
